hook: A fierce warrior remains enraged even after defeating all his enemies.

word.note: It is used to compare the warrior's unyielding battle anger to a powerful male elephant that has just fought a tiger.

excerpt: In his hand is the spear, on his feet are the adorned heroic anklets. His body is covered in sweat, and on his throat is a fresh wound. Having mixed the great flowers of veṭci and vēṅkai, he wears them beautifully on his curly dark hair. Like a strong male elephant that has fought a striped tiger, his anger has still not subsided, alas! Those who provoked him here have not survived. His eyes, which glared at his enemies...
